# Braverton

> Braverton is an AI-assisted software creation platform built by Leonard Udoh. It gives developers and creators a workspace to plan, build, test, and deploy websites, web apps, and software — from idea to production.

## What Braverton does

- **Bram**: An AI assistant that turns plain-language descriptions into structured build plans and coordinates development
- **Braverton OS**: An AI workspace combining project management, agent assistance, and deployment
- **BraverCode**: A developer tool and VS Code extension for AI-assisted coding
- **Services**: Professional services including AI Mockups, Code Reviews, and custom software builds
- **Integrations**: Vercel, Supabase, GitHub, Google Gemini, Paystack

## Who it is for

Developers, indie builders, and businesses in Nigeria and Africa who want to go from idea to working software.
